The best AI for financial research is Perplexity

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-18T15:38:03+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2123078289204126143; média: videó, 136 másodperc]
Perplexity turned Anthropic's IPO filing into an interactive explainer with animated 3D charts.

Explore quarterly revenue, adjust the IPO price to see how the offering size and valuation change, compare economic ownership with voting power, and dive deeper with plain-language explanations. All data is sourced from the S-1, with citations.

Our SkillBot teammate is working on a generalized skill, so that Perplexity users can create these interactive explainers for any topic.
